svg.title: ADS-B Transit Predictor Linux Web Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing a 1090 MHz antenna, RTL-SDR receiver, indoor Windows laptop, usbipd bridge to WSL, dump1090, ADS-B Transit Predictor HTTPS Web UI, Tailscale, and outdoor mobile device.
svg.text: ADS-B Transit Predictor Linux Web Architecture
1090 MHz receiver stack in WSL, HTTPS Web UI, and mobile access through Tailscale

g.text: Browser geolocation usually requires a secure context. A self-signed local certificate lets mobile browsers use GPS over LAN or Tailscale.
Certificate and private key are generated locally in .web_certs/ and are not included in release packages.
